extension.summary: Smooth Prime: Prime Video in the Aurora Cinema interface
extension.description: Smooth Prime is maintained by AgreeWithScotty. Catalog, account authentication, HTTPS transport, media resources, Widevine license relay, subtitles and playback lifecycle use independently written implementations. The dedicated Aurora interface is adapted from Scott's SmoothFlix. Not affiliated with Amazon. See NOTICE.md for asset and dependency licenses.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Amazon account and Kodi InputStream Adaptive with Widevine. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.news: 0.2.62[CR]- Read Amazon My Stuff pagination metadata and keep readable Watchlist titles with an explicit retry notice if later pages fail.[CR]- Prepare focused TV seasons in the background, share pending title reads and reuse decoded TV documents.[CR]- Show Amazon location-refusal details and record playback failures separately from user cancellations.[CR]- Use one fixed content-title size and one smaller continuation size, with equal canvases and wrapped overflow.[CR]- Request original-quality Amazon artwork for cards, posters, backgrounds, genres and Extras; remove reduced-size cache reuse.[CR]- Expand redacted pagination, artwork selection, source dimensions, provider-error and timing diagnostics.
